title: Post by tomcflower
description:
The art of building is very different from what you’re see online.

Most people promoting the hustle version of building a brand have never stood in a field at golden hour and felt what their brand is supposed to make people feel.

I don’t want Hormozi’s schedule.
I want mastery and presence.

Hard work is required.
But this game is seasonal.

And the weekends are not for catching up.
They’re for living the life your brand is supposed to represent.
